Khalid Pathan CBAP™

pathan.khalid@hotmail.com

+91 8618492665 www.linkedin.com/in/khalid-ahmad-7aab77287 B1-B2 USA Visa

2028.

Experienced Product Owner / Business Analyst aiming to utilize expertise in Agile methodologies, product backlog management, requirements engineering, and stakeholder engagement to deliver scalable digital products and support business transformation initiatives.

Results-driven Treasury professional with 10+ years of experience in financial services, specializing in Trading system implementation and support across front-to-back office operations. Proven expertise in UAT planning, test script design, regression testing, and post-production support for Treasury products including Money Market, FX, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and Collateral Management. Adept at collaborating with business stakeholders, IT teams, and vendors to deliver high-quality solutions in fast-paced, Agile environments. Strong analytical mindset with a focus on problem-solving, system optimization, and seamless execution of business-critical initiatives.

Strategic Product Owner / Lead Senior Business Analyst with 18+ years of experience delivering enterprise platforms across Capital Markets, Banking and Wealth & Asset Management. Proven ability to translate complex business needs into high-impact digital solutions, driving product strategy, backlog prioritization, and Agile delivery for trading, portfolio management, reconciliation, and regulatory reporting systems

Completed five onsite assignments in the USA for stakeholder meetings and strategic discussions, facilitating alignment between business and technology objectives. Participated in several domestic visits to support process transitions and cross-functional collaboration.

Strong functional expertise in requirement engineering, business process transformation, and enterprise solution design. Adept at converting business needs into functional specifications, user stories, system workflows, and data models that enable scalable architecture and high-performance systems.

Hands-on experience leveraging Generative AI tools for UI ideation, wire-framing, requirement drafting, and specification generation, accelerating documentation cycles and improving solution design efficiency.

Extensive experience working with global stakeholders, product owners, engineering teams, and business leaders across the US, EMEA, and APAC regions. Skilled in facilitating workshops, discovery sessions, and stakeholder alignment to ensure successful project delivery.

Proven expertise across Agile and Waterfall SDLC, including BRD/FRD creation, backlog management, UAT coordination, data mapping, and end-to-end implementation support. Known for driving process optimization, automation, and enterprise digital transformation initiatives.

Business Analysis & Solution Consulting • Banking, Capital Markets & Wealth Management • Process Modeling & Business Transformation • Data Analysis & Enterprise Integration • Agile Delivery & Stakeholder Management • AI-Assisted Requirements & Product Design

\\

Thought Focus Technologies April 2025 to Sept 2025

Bangalore

Lead Senior Business Analyst (Role Product Owner/Business Analyst) Project Goal: Loan Review SaaS Platform Implementation (People Trust)

Led the end-to-end implementation of a cloud-based Loan Review Management system to automate and streamline the annual loan review process.

Led Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring continuous delivery and team alignment.

Partnered with business stakeholders and engineering teams to define product strategy, roadmap, and prioritized backlog, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Owned and prioritized product backlog using Agile/Scrum practices • Collaborated with architects and technical teams to interpret solution designs, APIs, and system architecture for

defining functional and non-functional requirements.

• Facilitated cross-functional workshops and design sessions to align scope, priorities, and delivery outcomes across

business and IT.

Collaborated with stakeholders and development teams to deliver high-value features • Utilized AI-enabled tools for document classification, text extraction, summarization, and exception identification, reducing manual review effort and improving analyst productivity.

Worked closely with business and compliance teams to understand requirements and convert them into user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.

Created and executed functional test cases, validating system behavior and reducing post-release defects by 25%. Bangalore

HCL Technologies, Feb 2018 to April 2025

Project Manager (Role Product Owner/Business Analyst) Project: Developed ROW Optimization workflow exception management, portfolio and wealth management platforms, and risk and compliance regulatory projects (State Street/Munich_Re/PIMCO/Blackrock/Lazard)

Led the delivery of the MVP ROW Dashboard for DAG and Reconciliation, achieving a 20% reduction in reconciliation

turnaround time and significantly improving reporting accuracy and operational visibility.

Defined UAT strategy and designed comprehensive UAT test scripts across Money Market, FX, Fixed Income, Structured

Products, Derivatives, and Collateral Management, resulting in a 15% reduction in post-deployment defects.

Oversaw SIT/UAT validation, coordinated re-testing of failed scenarios, and managed regression testing, ensuring release

readiness and minimizing critical issues prior to production deployment.

Ensured adherence to capital markets regulatory requirements by strengthening data governance, reporting accuracy, and

control effectiveness across systems and processes.

Acted as a functional consultant providing end-to-end support to Front Office, Middle Office, and Operations teams. • Managed pre-go-live activities including Production Verification (PLV) testing and ensured readiness for system deployment. • Provided post-go-live support, troubleshooting system issues, and ensuring minimal disruption to business operations. • Coordinated and led UAT cycles with IT teams and third-party vendors, ensuring timely delivery and issue resolution. • Demonstrated deep understanding of Treasury processes and Summit system integrations across front-to-back office workflows.

Collaborated effectively with business and technical stakeholders, translating requirements into functional solutions. • Worked in Agile environments, adapting to evolving priorities and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. • Applied strong problem-solving and analytical skills to assess technical architecture and drive system enhancements. • Delivered both in-house and vendor-based IT solutions aligned with business needs and regulatory requirements. • Promoted a collaborative team environment with strong interpersonal and communication skills. • Played a key role in regulatory remediation initiatives by identifying control gaps, defining corrective action plans, and tracking closure to successful audit and compliance outcomes.

Managed project scope, budget, and schedule across multiple initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives and

timely delivery.

Led Project Working Group (PWG) and Steering Committee meetings, presenting project updates, risks, and key decisions to

senior stakeholders.

Prepared and maintained portfolio-level reporting, including project status, budget tracking, scope management, and delivery

timelines.

Produced weekly project status reports, highlighting milestones, progress, and potential delivery risks. • Managed RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) to proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks. • Facilitated Agile Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. • Collaborated closely with Product Owners to manage the product backlog, prioritize features, and support continuous feature delivery

NIIT Technologies, Feb 2014 to Jan 2018

Bangalore

Team Lead (Role Business Analyst) Project: Migrating mainframe-based Trust applications to the SWP Web Platform to enhance wealth management capabilities across all asset classes. (SEI)

Led legacy-to-digital transformation initiatives, migrating mainframe-based Trust systems to modern web-based

wealth management platforms, ensuring scalability, security, and performance optimization.

Applied SDLC and Agile methodologies to manage requirements lifecycle, change control, and delivery milestones,

ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical solutions.

Performed detailed AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, process modeling, and data mapping to support system integration,

migration readiness, and operational efficiency improvements.

Acted as the primary liaison between business, technology, and vendors, facilitating clear communication,

requirement sign-off, and dependency management across multiple workstreams.

• Supported data migration and integration testing, validating data accuracy, reconciliation outcomes, and exception

handling across trust, portfolio, and client account data.

Defined functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria, enabling development teams to deliver high-

quality, compliant solutions with reduced rework.

Conducted SIT, UAT, and regression testing coordination, reviewing test cases, validating outcomes, and driving

defect resolution prior to production release.

Ensured adherence to regulatory, compliance, and data governance standards, supporting audit readiness and

reducing operational and compliance risks.

Delivered stakeholder workshops, walkthroughs, and end-user training, driving adoption of new platforms and

improving user experience across front and back-office teams.

Monitored project risks, dependencies, and delivery metrics, providing regular status updates and ensuring on-time,

on-budget delivery of complex transformation programs.

State Street Pvt Ltd, Apr 2007 to Jan 2014

Pune/Mumbai

Senior Analyst (Role: SME/Business Analyst/ Testing) Project: Managed end-to-end business analysis for the Portfolio Manager Project, supporting custodians, middle office, and back-office operations across daily FX, equity, and fixed income trade reconciliation workflows.

Managed end-to-end business analysis across custodian, middle-office, and back-office operations, supporting daily FX,

Equity, and Fixed Income trade reconciliation and settlement workflows.

Collaborated closely with traders, operations, risk, and technology teams to design and deliver solutions that improved

operational throughput and reduced reconciliation errors by 20%.

Led requirements elicitation, analysis, and prioritization through workshops, interviews, and walkthroughs, enabling

delivery of scalable and regulatory-compliant applications.

Coordinated with onshore stakeholders and clients for requirement validation, UAT support, knowledge transfer, and end-

user training, achieving 95% satisfaction scores in post-implementation surveys.

Identified opportunities for process automation and operational efficiency, reducing manual interventions and enhancing

system reliability.

Provided actionable insights and recommendations to improve workflows across trade settlement, corporate actions, and risk

monitoring.

Certified Business Analyst Professional™ CBAP (International Institute of Business Analysis –IIBA) • Certified SAFe® Product Owner & Product Manager (Scaled Agile, Inc.)

Diploma in Digital Transformation and Operational Excellence MTF Institute

Diploma in Retail Banking and Wealth Management

Process Mapping with BPMN 2.0 (GBTEC Group)

AI Tools Workshop (Be10x)

ICFAI Uni v e r s i t y M BA ( Finance)

2007 Pune MH

North Maharashtra University Bachelor of commence (Banking & Accountancy)

2004 Jalgaon MH

ROW DAG & Reconciliation Project (Exception Management)-Implemented Read-Optimized Write Directed Acyclic Graph (ROW DAG) optimization and a reconciliation framework, which reduced exception rates by 30% and increased operational transparency across reporting teams.

Application Migration Project (TLM vs TLP Reconciliation) Led the migration of over critical business applications from legacy TLM to TLP reconciliation platforms, managing a large-scale, high complexity project that resulted in a 30% reduction in processing errors and significantly improved audit compliance. Coordinated cross-functional teams and designed automated data validation scripts to ensure a seamless transition, maintaining 100% data integrity and uninterrupted process continuity throughout the migration.

Fail Station Setup – Led the design and implementation of a robust failover DAG setup across multiple asset classes by coordinating cross-functional teams and developing automated failover scripts, which reduced system downtime by 40% and ensured uninterrupted business operations during outages.

Portfolio Management System Implementation – Led the implementation and integration of Portfolio Management and Investment platforms including Charles River Investment Management Solution, BlackRock Aladdin, PIMS, Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation, CTM, and Eagle Investment Systems to support trading, reconciliation, portfolio accounting, and post-trade operations across asset classes.

Forward FX Netting : (Integrated with CRTS) : Led and contributed to the implementation of a Forward FX Netting solution aimed at optimizing settlement processes and reducing counterparty exposure. The project involved gathering business requirements from Treasury stakeholders, designing netting logic for FX forward deals, and developing UAT scenarios to validate end-to-end workflows. Coordinated closely with IT teams and vendors to ensure accurate system configuration within the Summit platform. Successfully executed UAT, identified and resolved defects, and ensured smooth deployment. The solution improved operational efficiency, reduced settlement volumes, and enhanced risk management through effective netting mechanisms.

Investment & Capital Markets Platforms: Bloomberg, TLM, Charles River, Aladdin, PIMS, DTCC, CTM, Fail station, Eagle Investment Systems, Portfolio Management Systems, Trade Lifecycle Management, Reconciliation Platforms, Regulatory Reporting, Custody Operations, Wealth Management Platforms.
